title: DAY 2 — LESSON 3: AVOIDING GOSSIP, MOCKERY, CLIQUES AND UNHEALTHY COMPETITION

questions.prompt: Which situation best describes workplace gossip?
options: Reporting a safety concern to a supervisor
Spreading an unverified rumour about a colleague's private life
Sharing an appointment update with the assigned therapist

questions.prompt: A new therapist makes a mistake. What should an experienced colleague do?
options: Correct her respectfully and explain the procedure
Mock her in front of other staff

questions.prompt: When does a friendship group become an unhealthy clique?
options: When colleagues occasionally have lunch together
When the group deliberately excludes or undermines other employees

questions.prompt: What is an example of healthy competition?
options: Improving your own skills and celebrating others' achievements
Discouraging clients from booking another therapist

questions.prompt: A colleague begins spreading a rumour. What is the best response?
options: Avoid spreading it and redirect genuine concerns to appropriate channels
Add your own assumptions to the story
